auxiliary_preview_snapshot.label: G4c_free preview snapshot (audited at 19:10, superseded)
auxiliary_preview_snapshot.note: the 05_arm_G4c_free/best_valid file was updated after this preview (SHA changed), so its final counts differ from this snapshot

three_way_crossing_convention.convention: identical: flat parts grouped by physical z, strict D56 2-D audit (0.080 mm centreline + legal transverse crossing exemption >= 5 deg, local window <= 4 mm); the same frozen D56Index/AuditRoutePairs code path is used for all three columns, and each column was independently recomputed here

manual_u_migration.contract_note: manual_group labels are preserved (368 routes); the manual geometry itself is optimisable under fully_optimizable (same policy as G3), NOT frozen

glass.edge_margin_note: the two interface ports sit exactly on the 150 mm board edge (centreline margin 0), so the -25 um edge margin is a known property of the exploratory centreline model and is not counted as a glass violation here

crossing_exemption_policy.same_physical_height_rule: strict D56 2-D centreline clearance 0.08 mm (width 0.05 + edge gap 0.03); legal transverse crossings exempt
crossing_exemption_policy.different_physical_height_rule: legal when |dz| >= 0.05 mm; XY overlap alone is not a violation
crossing_exemption_policy.transition_rule: true 3-D centreline distance >= 0.05 mm to every other route (transition-vs-flat, transition-vs-transition)
